output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is transferred from 'this' to 'target' without any check, causing the totalSupply to become extremely large, if exploited, it will permanently block the contract.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing the _value to be of any arbitrary large value, if exploited, it will permanently block the assets of the recipients.

The _transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing the _value to be of any arbitrary large value, if exploited, it will permanently block the assets of the recipients.
